## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Kāyasaṁsagga-sikkhāpada* (Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Saṅghādisesa 2) is the second rule in the Saṅghādisesa chapter of the Theravāda *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* within the Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule establishes that a monk overcome by lust who engages in physical contact with a woman incurs an offense entailing initial and subsequent meetings of the Saṅgha, resulting in formal suspension. An English translation of the rule and its associated narrative framing has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
